title: Per-frame residual RMS after tip/tilt removal

parent.relation: additive scalar derivative of the saved residual maps; the dataset, its PSFs, its images and its galaxy derivative are unchanged

definition.quantity: residual RMS after tip/tilt removal (piston and fitted tilt removed)
definition.field: pre_update_residual_opd_m of frame k: the frame's recorded atmosphere minus the DM correction held while the frame was measured; the same wavefront whose image is the AO-corrected instantaneous PSF of frame k
definition.fit: p(x, y) = a + b x + c y, equal-weight linear least squares over the illuminated pupil samples of the saved pupil mask
definition.formula: detilted_rms_nm[k] = 1e9 * sqrt(mean((r_k - p_k)^2 over the pupil samples)); the fitted intercept a removes piston
definition.weighting: every illuminated pupil sample has equal weight, as in the existing piston-removed RMS (shwfs_ao.core.wavefront.masked_rms)
definition.exterior: samples outside the pupil are excluded (NaN in the archive), never treated as zero; a non-finite value inside the pupil refuses the computation
definition.timing: frame-start sampling: frame k starts at t_k = k / 1000 s; the residual is the pre-update residual the WFS measured in frame k
definition.frame_mapping: values[k] belongs to numerical frame k (k = 0..999); the page maps its displayed position through time_domain.display_indices to k and never interpolates

companions.atmosphere_rms_nm: the dataset's existing per-frame series: pupil RMS of atmosphere_opd_m, piston removed, tilt retained
companions.residual_rms_nm: the dataset's existing per-frame series: pupil RMS of pre_update_residual_opd_m, piston removed, tilt retained (total residual)

scope: Tilt is removed only in this calculation. The displayed PSFs and galaxy images keep their original image motion and morphology; no correction was applied to them.
The total residual includes tilt; the residual after tip/tilt removal separates the fitted wavefront tilt from the remaining higher-order error.
A fitted wavefront plane is not the same quantity as a measured image-centroid motion.
The atmosphere RMS keeps its tilt while this residual has its fitted tilt removed, so their ratio alone is not a like-for-like measure of AO correction efficiency.
A smaller detilted RMS is not evidence of convergence and is not an additional correction applied to the images.

coordinates.source: native Shack-Hartmann geometry of the plan's configuration (x_m, y_m), as admitted before production

baseline.label: Mean of per-frame RMS, 0.200–1.000 s, 800 frames
baseline.definition: arithmetic mean of the per-frame RMS values of frames in the window; a temporal mean of scalars, not the RMS of an averaged wavefront and not inferred from the average PSF
